titre: After accepting revisions, re-read the seams
regle: Before delivering a version in which revisions are accepted, look for defective seams: a word cut by a deletion, an insertion placed at the end of a paragraph, bold inherited from the first word, an empty paragraph left by a deletion; repair them from the tracked source and log them.
source: Final version v6.0.10-rev1: 11 text repairs and 22 bold corrections, all due to earlier passes by Claude, invisible as long as the document stayed under tracked changes.
application: Tools moteur_revision_multi (placement of insertions) and accepter_auteurs; detector coutures_v2.
controle: Seam detector with no K1/K2/K3 case left in the accepted view.
